arguments.query: select b.*, (select group_concat(charge_id||":"||status) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch from bookings b where status!="confirmed"

select o.event_id,o.status,o.attempts,substr(o.payload,1,20) p, o.payload like "%"||o.booking_id||"%" match, b.status bs from outbox o left join bookings b on b.booking_id=o.booking_id where o.status!="delivered"
select event_id,status,attempts,payload from outbox where status<>"delivered"
select b.booking_id,b.status,b.client_reference,c.charge_id,c.status cs,c.idempotency_key from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where b.status<>"confirmed"
select b.booking_id,b.status,b.client_reference,c.charge_id,c.status cs,c.idempotency_key from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where b.status<>"confirmed"
select sql from sqlite_master where name in ("charges","bookings","holds")

select b.booking_id,b.client_reference cr,c.charge_id,c.state,c.idempotency_key,c.created_step,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where b.status="pending"

select b.status, count(*) n, sum(b.booking_id in (select booking_id from checkins)) ci, sum(b.booking_id in (select booking_id from holds)) h, sum((select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and c.state="captured")=1) ch1 from bookings b group by b.status
select * from customer_events where booking_id in (select booking_id from bookings where status="cancelled" or client_reference="CR-622ccc9195e1")
select * from customer_events order by rowid desc limit 8
